# Delims may be set in one statement and the template parsed in another.
# The delimiters in effect have to carry across, or the scan looks for
# {{ }} in a template written with [[ ]], finds no clause, and reports
# nothing at all while the check itself still passes.

check-templates -definitions
cmpenv stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- want.txt --
$WORK/main.go:11:40+21	"greeting"	$WORK/main.go:11:63+7	$WORK/main.go:11:49+10
-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

var templates = template.New("app").Delims("[[", "]]")

var _ = template.Must(templates.Parse(`[[define "greeting"]]Hi[[end]]`))

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func handleIndex(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_ = templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint
